scripts.build: pnpm run build:react && pnpm run build:comp-lib && rsbuild build && cross-env REACTLYNX_ASYNC=true pnpm run build:comp-lib && cross-env REACTLYNX_ASYNC=true rsbuild build
scripts.dev: pnpm run build:react && pnpm run build:comp-lib:dev && rsbuild dev
scripts.dev:react-async: pnpm run build:react && cross-env REACTLYNX_ASYNC=true pnpm run build:comp-lib:dev && cross-env REACTLYNX_ASYNC=true rsbuild dev
scripts.build:react: cross-env NODE_ENV=production rslib build --config rslib-react.config.ts && cross-env NODE_ENV=development rslib build --config rslib-react.config.ts
